01 RealTerra

Field mapping

Built in, no extra module: during autonomous flight it captures HD images, stitches them into a field map and hands it over right after landing. AI recognises obstacles, hilly fields get a 3D model preview, and prescription maps enable variable-rate application.

Mapped per flight
30 ha
Model for hilly terrain
3D
Variable rate by map
VRA

02 RevoSpray 5

Spraying

Intelligent centrifugal nozzles and two flexible-impeller pumps meter the liquid precisely, and the downdraft of four rotors drives droplets deep into dense canopies. With the 4-Nozzle Upgrade Kit (sold separately), flow rises to 46 L/min — recommended for orchards and vineyards.

4-Nozzle Upgrade Kit in the shop

03 RevoCast 5

Granule spreading

A vertical waving spreader with a direct-drive motor keeps the pattern even, even in wind. Large, medium and small screw feeders handle granules up to 10 mm — fertiliser, seed, feed — and the container fills from both sides. RevoCast 5 is an optional module, sold separately.

Granule container
115 L
Max spread rate*
300 kg/min
Effective width
9 m
Max granule size
10 mm

04 RevoSling

Cargo transport

Delivers farm inputs, harvest, seedling trays and saplings to hard-to-reach places. Secure load lock with automatic release, A/B routes, custom tracks for hilly terrain and live in-flight weighing. RevoSling is an optional system, sold separately.

Max payload
80 kg
Max speed with cargo
13.8 m/s

05 SuperX 5 Ultra

Flight and safety

A 4D imaging radar sees power poles, wires, centre pivots and other obstacles, day and night. Map-free 3D terrain following: the drone builds its 3D map in flight. A wide-angle FPV camera marks obstacles in AR, and the drone hovers automatically when something looks wrong.

Max flight speed
20 m/s
Radar range
1.5–100 m
Computing power vs SuperX 5 Pro
2.5×

06 B141050 · CM13600S · GC4000+

Power and charging

A 1050 Wh battery (warranty: 1 year or 1500 cycles). One CM13600S charger takes it from 30% to 95% in about 12 minutes, the parallel kit in 7. The mist cooling tank runs 6–8 hours on one fill, and the GC4000+ generator keeps you independent in the field. Single-battery mode: 50 L of liquid or 40 kg of granules.

Battery energy
1050 Wh
Charge 30→95%, parallel
7 min
Charger output
3.4 kW

07 XAG One · SRC 5 · XRTK 7

Build and control

IPX6K: wash the drone down with water. 63-inch propellers, folding arms and a modular build for transport. In the XAG One app: routes from the field shape, up to 10 fields per mission, two drones at once, and automatic return when liquid or power runs low. SRC 5 remote: 7-inch high-brightness screen, 8 hours of use. For centimetre accuracy, the XRTK 7 mobile station.
